bukhari-1.arabic: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
bukhari-1.translation: The reward of deeds depends upon the intentions and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended.

bukhari-1427-1428.translation: The upper hand is better than the lower hand (i.e. he who gives in charity is better than him who takes it).

bayhaqi-4929.translation: Allah Most High loves that when any of you does a task, he does it well.

bukhari-5027.translation: The best among you (Muslims) are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.

muslim-2699a.translation:
Whoever eases a believer's distress in this life, Allah will ease a distress for them on the Day of Resurrection. Whoever gives relief to someone in financial hardship, Allah will give them relief in this life and the next. Whoever conceals a Muslim's faults, Allah will conceal theirs in this life and the next. Allah helps His servant while that servant helps their brother.

Whoever follows a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make a path to Paradise easier for them through it. Whenever people gather in one of Allah's houses, reciting His Book and studying it together, tranquillity descends upon them, mercy embraces them, angels surround them, and Allah mentions them among those in His presence. Whoever falls behind because of their deeds will not be brought forward by their ancestry.
muslim-2699a.translationSource: English rendering prepared for this preview from the Arabic; see Sunnah.com for its published translation.

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam Muslim in his Sahih collection

muslim-2735c-impatience.arabic: لاَ يَزَالُ يُسْتَجَابُ لِلْعَبْدِ مَا لَمْ يَدْعُ بِإِثْمٍ أَوْ قَطِيعَةِ رَحِمٍ مَا لَمْ يَسْتَعْجِلْ. قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الاِسْتِعْجَالُ قَالَ يَقُولُ قَدْ دَعَوْتُ وَقَدْ دَعَوْتُ فَلَمْ أَرَ يَسْتَجِيبُ لِي فَيَسْتَحْسِرُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ وَيَدَعُ الدُّعَاءَ
muslim-2735c-impatience.translation: The supplication of the servant is granted in case he does not supplicate for sin or for severing the ties of blood, or he does not become impatient. It was said: Allah's Messenger, what does:" If he does not grow impatient" imply? He said: That he should say like this: I supplicated and I supplicated but I did not find it being responded. and [then] he becomes frustrated and abandons supplication.

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam Muslim in his Sahih collection

adab-710-three-outcomes.arabic: مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يَدْعُو، لَيْسَ بِإِثْمٍ وَلاَ بِقَطِيعَةِ رَحِمٍ، إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِحْدَى ثَلاَثٍ: إِمَّا أَنْ يُعَجِّلَ لَهُ دَعْوَتَهُ، وَإِمَّا أَنْ يَدَّخِرَهَا لَهُ فِي الْآخِرَةِ، وَإِمَّا أَنْ يَدْفَعَ عَنْهُ مِنَ السُّوءِ مِثْلَهَا، قَالَ: إِذًا نُكْثِرُ، قَالَ: اللَّهُ أَكْثَرُ.
adab-710-three-outcomes.translation: "No Muslim makes supplication - unless he is someone who has cut off his relatives - but that he is given one of three things: either his supplication is answered quickly, or it is stored up for him in the Next World, or an evil equal to it is averted from him." It was said, "Then many supplications will be made." He replied, "Allah has more still to give."

grade.attributedTo: Al-Albani, Sahih al-Adab al-Mufrad, as listed by Dorar.net
Al-Albani, as recorded with Sunan Abi Dawud 1479

bukhari-1303-ibrahim.arabic: إِنَّ الْعَيْنَ تَدْمَعُ، وَالْقَلْبَ يَحْزَنُ، وَلاَ نَقُولُ إِلاَّ مَا يَرْضَى رَبُّنَا، وَإِنَّا بِفِرَاقِكَ يَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَمَحْزُونُونَ
bukhari-1303-ibrahim.translation: The eyes are shedding tears and the heart is grieved, and we will not say except what pleases our Lord, O Ibrahim! Indeed we are grieved by your separation.
bukhari-1303-ibrahim.translationSource: Dr. M. Muhsin Khan, via Sunnah.com

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam al-Bukhari in his Sahih collection

bukhari-7405-good-opinion.arabic: يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي
bukhari-7405-good-opinion.translation: Allah says: 'I am just as My slave thinks I am, (i.e. I am able to do for him what he thinks I can do for him) and I am with him if He remembers Me.
bukhari-7405-good-opinion.translationSource: Dr. M. Muhsin Khan, via Sunnah.com

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam al-Bukhari in his Sahih collection

muslim-35b-branches.arabic: الإِيمَانُ بِضْعٌ وَسَبْعُونَ أَوْ بِضْعٌ وَسِتُّونَ شُعْبَةً فَأَفْضَلُهَا قَوْلُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَدْنَاهَا إِمَاطَةُ الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ وَالْحَيَاءُ شُعْبَةٌ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ
muslim-35b-branches.translation: Faith has over seventy branches or over sixty branches, the most excellent of which is the declaration that there is no god but Allah, and the humblest of which is the, removal of what is injurious from the path: and modesty is a branch of faith.

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam Muslim in his Sahih collection

bukhari-2472-branch.arabic: بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي بِطَرِيقٍ، وَجَدَ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ فَأَخَذَهُ، فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ، فَغَفَرَ لَهُ
bukhari-2472-branch.translation: While a man was on the way, he found a thorny branch of a tree there on the way and removed it. Allah thanked him for that deed and forgave him.
bukhari-2472-branch.translationSource: Dr. M. Muhsin Khan, via Sunnah.com

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam al-Bukhari in his Sahih collection

bukhari-6464-consistent.arabic: سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا، وَاعْلَمُوا أَنْ لَنْ يُدْخِلَ أَحَدَكُمْ عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ، وَأَنَّ أَحَبَّ الأَعْمَالِ أَدْوَمُهَا إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَإِنْ قَلَّ
bukhari-6464-consistent.translation: Do good deeds properly, sincerely and moderately and know that your deeds will not make you enter Paradise, and that the most beloved deed to Allah is the most regular and constant even if it were little.
bukhari-6464-consistent.translationSource: Dr. M. Muhsin Khan, via Sunnah.com

grade.attributedTo: Included by Imam al-Bukhari in his Sahih collection
